description: Get full details for a specific US state bill by jurisdiction, session, and bill identifier. Returns complete legislative history including all actions (committee referrals, readings, amendments, final votes), sponsor information, abstract/summary, and roll-call vote counts. Obtain jurisdiction and session from bills_search results. Example: jurisdiction="ca", session="20252026", bill_id="SB 700".

bill_id.description: Bill identifier within the session (e.g. "SB 700", "HB 1234", "SR 5"). Obtain from bills_search results.

jurisdiction.description: State abbreviation where the bill was introduced (e.g. "ca" for California, "ny" for New York).

session.description: Legislative session identifier the bill belongs to (e.g. "20252026", "2024"). Obtain from bills_search results.

name: openstates.legislature.bill_detail

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Get Bill Details
